correctness.rationale: For degree d the N=(d+1)^2 lifted nodes lambda^a conjugate(lambda)^b are distinct iff d<q(theta), by comparing moduli and phases, giving exact invertible first-N Vandermonde. The explicit 1±iz^q ambiguity proves necessity. For arbitrary holomorphic f,g, equal moduli at accumulating spiral points force equal zero order; a nonconstant quotient would produce a cosine of an irrational dense rotation that must decay geometrically, contradiction. The zero case and analytic continuation are covered. Exact symbolic finite checks corroborate but do not replace these infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Gives an if-and-only-if arithmetic design criterion for one-complex-ratio phaseless sampling, with an exact polynomial degree ceiling, an explicit finite full-intensity reconstruction, and a surprising all-holomorphic uniqueness result from one sample per radius and per ray. The classification isolates irrational angular mixing as a structural cause of uniqueness, while providing exact low-degree rational exceptions. No minimal nonlinear measurement count or practical stability is claimed.
